$comment: Ad products and ad-text rules that a media plan may lean on, each with where it was read and how sure that is. The paid-advertising skill reads this before it names one of these products in a plan: a row whose status is reported, or whose availability is not live, is named as unconfirmed and checked in the brand's own ad account before spend is planned on it. No prose about a product goes into a skill until a page about it has been read; this file is where a product waits. tests/test_paid_products.py checks every row and fails 30 days before any review_by (DMP_TODAY=YYYY-MM-DD freezes today; the weekly dated job runs it). Added in 3.41.0 from the 2026-10-27 trends audit (finding 28).
schema: each row: platform, product, kind (what it does, in words that outlive the product name), status (read = the page at source_url was read on verified_on; reported = no vendor page could be read, and the row rests on the named secondary source), availability (live | beta | rolling_out | announced), since (the date it reached that availability, null if not stated), source_url, source_date, verified_on, review_by, note

products.kind: ad retrieval model: picks a few thousand candidate ads from tens of millions before ranking and the auction
products.note: Meta's engineering post. There is no advertiser setting; an ad that is not retrieved is never ranked.

products.kind: account recommendation score (0-100) in Ads Manager
products.note: REPORTED: available to all advertisers from 2025-06-09 (PPC Land, on Meta's announcement); the score rises as Ads Manager recommendations are applied, weighted by their estimated impact. It measures how many recommendations were taken, not results: never report it to a client as performance.

products.kind: flight budget: one total for a fixed start and end date instead of an average daily budget
products.note: Google Ads blog, 2026-01-15: 'now available in open beta' for Search, Performance Max and Shopping campaigns, for flights 'from a few days to a few weeks'. The help FAQ (support.google.com/google-ads/answer/15137812) also names Demand Gen and YouTube. Use it for launches and sales; a daily-budget campaign is not converted, so a total budget means a new campaign.

products.kind: query-matched shopping: the AI Max search expansion applied to Shopping campaigns
products.note: Google Marketing Live, 2026-05-20: advertisers reach the AI Mode ad formats by building on 'AI Max for Search, AI Max for Shopping campaigns and Performance Max'. The post gives no date or control detail for the Shopping toggle; check the account's campaign settings.

products.kind: goal-and-guardrail brief that steers an automated campaign's audience reach
products.note: Google Marketing Live, 2026-05-20: advertisers 'will soon be able to supply their eligible products and guardrails and use AI Brief to reach the right audiences'. Announced, no date: do not plan on it until it shows in the account.

products.kind: monthly feature releases for Demand Gen campaigns
products.note: Google publishes Demand Gen changes as a monthly 'drop' (the blog's related story 'Build your data strength with October's Demand Gen drop'). Read the latest drop before a Demand Gen plan; this row records the cadence, not any one drop's contents.

products.kind: automated shop-sales campaign optimising gross merchandise value
products.note: REPORTED: the only campaign type for TikTok Shop destinations since July 2025 (trade press); at Advertising Week (2026-10-05) TikTok said GMV Max will count affiliate commissions, coupons and referral fees in its optimisation, with no date. ads.tiktok.com does not load from India.

products.kind: agentic checkout: buying inside TikTok on a partner merchant's catalogue
products.note: REPORTED: announced at Advertising Week New York on 2026-10-05 with Salesforce, Shopify, Shoplazza and Stripe named as partners; no launch date was given.

products.kind: chat lead generation in TikTok messages and on the advertiser's own lead forms

products.note: REPORTED: announced 2026-10-05 with Smart+ Creative Selection. From 2027-01-01 non-search campaigns are created only through the Upgraded Smart+ APIs (paid-advertising/SKILL.md).

products.product: TikTok Ad Network in the US
products.kind: third-party app inventory for TikTok campaigns
products.note: REPORTED: the ad network (about 400,000 third-party apps worldwide) opened to US advertisers. Treat it as a placement with its own brand-safety review.

products.kind: lead-ad bidding toward leads the CRM later qualifies
products.note: REPORTED: launched April 2025. It needs the LinkedIn Conversions API: qualified leads go back from the CRM, at least five every two weeks, each within 30 days of the lead. Plan it only where the CRM sync exists (crm-sync).

products.kind: automated campaign suite: bidding, creative and audience automation in one campaign type
products.note: Pinterest's business page (undated): Performance+ campaigns bundle the suite's features. Its FAQ lists consideration, leads and sales; a feature line says consideration, conversions and catalogue sales. Confirm the objective in Ads Manager.
REPORTED: X rejects an ad with a hashtag in its text (press reports of X's 2025-06-26 notice; business.x.com does not load from here). Organic posts are unaffected.

products.product: Ad text: one emoji, no URLs
products.note: REPORTED: X's ad quality policy (July 2025, a law-firm summary): more than one emoji in ad copy or creative lowers the quality score and can raise the price (ads targeting only Japan or Korea are exempt), and a URL belongs in the card, not in the ad text.
